title: Implement Services section variants (services-grid, services-list)
description: Implement two Services section variants. services-grid shows services in a responsive card grid. services-list shows services as a vertical list with icon + title + description.
acceptanceCriteria: Both accept `{ content: ServicesContent, business: BusinessInfo }` props
Both render all items from content.items
Each item shows title and description; icon shown if present
Colors use CSS custom properties only
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Section with a headline (content.headline or 'Our Services'). Responsive grid: `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6`. Each card: icon (emoji or lucide icon), title (h3), description. Card background: `bg-[--color-surface]`, border: `border-[--color-border]`.

Section with headline. Vertical list of items. Each item: flex row with icon/number on left, title + description on right. Divider between items using `--color-border`. Alternating background on hover.
Take a Playwright screenshot of a generated site preview that includes a services section. Confirm cards/list items are visible, text is readable, layout is responsive.

technicalNotes: If content.items is empty, render a placeholder with 3 dummy items to avoid layout breaks during development.
Use Lucide React icons for service icons if available, otherwise use colored circle with initials as fallback.
